_schema._about: Every nav string and href (CONTRACT §3). Slugs under /services/ and /solutions/ are defined here and are canonical for the whole site — the services, solutions and footer agents read them from this file. Clean URLs, no trailing slash, no .html.
_schema.logo: {href, onDark, onLight, alt}. Centre lockup: -on-dark on dark pages, -on-light on sand/white pages (the engine flips data-nav). Min 160px wide.
_schema.left: array[5] in order. {label, type: 'menu' | 'link', menu (key into menus) | href}.
_schema.right: array[2]. {label, href, primary: bool}. primary = the translucent pill with the jam arrow circle.
_schema.menus.services: Lance's Product menu: {columns[2]: array of {label, desc (~7 words), href}, newCard: {tag, title, desc, href, cta}}. 4 + 4 items plus the 'New' card = the nine services.
_schema.menus.solutions: Lance's Solutions menu: {columns[2]: {heading, items: [{label, desc, href}]}} — 'By goal' (6) and 'By brand' (3).
_schema.menus.resources: Lance's Resources menu: {items[4]: {label, href}, card: {label, href, video, poster, alt}} — the card is a looping muted clip with a label beneath.
_schema.mobile: {toggle, close, items[8]}. Full-screen accordion as ref/mobile/menu_open.jpg: items with type 'accordion' open to the menu's items (services: all nine incl. founder-led; solutions: both columns), type 'link' navigate. The mobile bar keeps right[] (Creators · Book a call) and the lockup.
